question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Having a feeling of guilt
solution:
The correct answer is '**Remorse**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Remorse**'.
 
• **Remorse** - (पछतावा): A feeling of deep regret or guilt for doing something wrong or hurtful.
 
 
• *Example: He felt a deep sense of **remorse** after cheating on the test.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Remorse.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**
